name: msm-2026-06
label_criteria: Bad = out of focus, clumped, debris, or cut off at the image edge. Dividing cells are good.
trainer: ModelPrep (June 2026), since integrated into MycoMorph as mycomorph.modelprep
summary: M. smegmatis cell-quality classifier (June 2026). Labels each segmented cell good or bad.
training_data: 60 randomly sampled fields from condition-optimisation experiments for a DNA-damage screen: ATc induction with and without mitomycin C (MMC), an MMC concentration series, and ATc concentration, cell density and exposure tests. CRISPRi knockdowns of lexA, dnaE2, imuA, imuB and recA, plus non-targeting controls, with the DnaN-mCherry and ImuB-eGFP reporters. 46% of labelled cells come from MMC-treated fields, so the model has seen many filamentous cells.
imaging: Phase contrast, 0.072 um per pixel (no binning), single plane. Segmented with Cellpose-SAM (cpsam weights, automatic diameter) using a Cellpose 4 release whose exact version was not recorded, after edge and debris rules.
labels: 6,028 cells labelled in ModelPrep by T. de Wet, mostly chosen by active learning. Split: 3,942 training, 986 validation, 1,100 held out. The held-out cells were labelled first and kept out of every training round.
training: Fine-tuned over 10 active-learning rounds in ModelPrep (13-14 June 2026), starting from a model trained from scratch on the first 500 labels; only M. smegmatis labels were used. Same input and settings as the M. tuberculosis preset; best epoch 39 of 40 in the final round.
performance: 80.5% agreement with hand labels on the 1,100 held-out cells, 92% of which the model found hard, so this understates performance on typical fields. The annotator agreed with their own earlier labels on 90% of 200 re-labelled cells (kappa 0.80). Validation on independent sessions: MycoMorph paper, Figure S2b.
intended_use: M. smegmatis phase-contrast images like these, at 0.072 um per pixel without binning, including filamenting cells after DNA damage. Retrain with ModelPrep for other organisms or imaging setups.
decision_threshold_note: Tuned on validation; opt-in. MycoMorph uses 0.5 by default.
